title: Bow Before Your Maker

body:
John contemplated the breathtaking view before him with a sense of wonder. Turning to his wife, he voiced his thoughts aloud. “Surely the Rocky Mountains are among God’s most magnificent creations! How can anyone view them and not believe in God the Creator?”


Phyllis squeezed his hand. “And consider that God is not only the Creator of the heavens and the earth and all that is in them, but He is also our Heavenly Father who loving cares for each of us!”

Godless evolutionists, promoting fiction as fact, doggedly resist the truth of God’s Word. Some wise person has observed that it requires a great deal more faith to believe in evolution than to simply believe what the Bible says:


In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth (Genesis 1:1).


Should we believe God, who loves us and gave himself for us, or believe the evil one, who hates followers of Christ and wants to see us destroyed? Believing God’s Word is a matter of everlasting life or eternal death.

Prayer Suggestion:

Come, let us bow down in worship, let us kneel before the Lord our Maker.
